summary: Task 5 (Advanced Analytics/Reports) tested end-to-end. Backend: 21 pytest cases across /api/reports/sales, /analytics, /by-category, /by-workshop, /abc, /corrections — all 21 passed (shape, math consistency, sorting, cum_pct monotonicity + ~100% terminal value, ABC class monotonicity, date-range filtering, cross-report total reconciliation, 403 for waiter/admin-PIN tokens, 401/403 without auth). Frontend: manager email/password login -> /admin/reports, all 5 tabs render and load data; found and fixed a real UI defect where the local Card component swallowed data-testid so ABC and Удаления panels had no test ids (panels rendered but were untestable/unidentifiable). After fix all tabs, ABC metric switch (revenue->count reorders rows), charts, margin table, and date filters verified working.

minor.issue: metric query param is not validated (any value silently falls back to revenue) — prefer Literal['revenue','count'] to return 422 on bad input
Date filtering is done in Python after fetching up to 20000 orders (to_list) instead of a Mongo query on closed_at — will not scale

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by tester: Card component did not forward extra props, so data-testid=report-panel-abc and report-panel-corrections were never emitted to the DOM

issues: Date range uses native browser date inputs (type=date) instead of the shadcn calendar/popover used elsewhere — inconsistent with dark theme (light native picker panel)
ABC metric selector is a raw native <select> (light-on-dark OS dropdown) instead of shadcn Select
No loading/error UI states: every useQuery destructures only data with defaults, so a failed report request shows an empty/zeroed panel with no feedback
Category chart shows a 'Без категории ×1' row (Чай, revenue 2.00 ₽) — product has no category_id in seed data; cosmetic data-quality issue

action_items: Add isLoading/isError handling to the 6 useQuery calls in Reports.jsx (currently silent failures)
Replace native date inputs / native select on Reports page with shadcn Calendar + Select for theme consistency
Validate abc metric with Literal type; consider Mongo-side date filtering for report queries
Optional: assign a category to seed product 'Чай' to remove the 'Без категории' bucket
critical_code_review_comments: Reports.jsx: shared Card helper must spread ...rest — silently dropping props broke test ids (fixed); watch for the same pattern in other admin pages
reports endpoints load full order collections into memory; add indexed Mongo filters on status/closed_at
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded closed orders (124 orders, 1841.50 ₽ in last 7 days)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Report endpoints regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_reports_iter8.py (uses conftest admin/waiter/cashier fixtures). Reports UI testids: report-tab-{sales,analytics,category,abc,corrections}, report-panel-*, margin-row-i, cat-row-i, ws-row-i, abc-row-i, abc-metric, report-start/report-end. Only Task 5 was in scope this iteration.
rca_of_the_issue: ABC/corrections panels appeared missing to automation because Reports.jsx's Card = ({children, className}) destructured only those props; data-testid passed to <Card> was discarded. Fixed by spreading ...rest onto the wrapper div; verified both panels are now locatable and populated.
